verdict: Lead cost fell sharply, but 7 leads in 28 days signals a volume problem.
narrative: Your cost per lead dropped nearly 50% week-over-week as Meta spend became more efficient — that improvement is real. However, only 7 leads arrived over the full 28-day window, which means efficiency is up on a very low volume base, not a sign of overall health. Two issues are compressing volume: the "Quality HVAC by Fibid" Google Business Profile is showing in local search but producing zero calls and zero direction requests, pointing to a broken listing configuration that is being corrected now. In parallel, several planned milestones — including the LSA heating toggle and the intake owner confirmation that unlocks paid scale-up — are overdue and being pushed to completion this week; once those are cleared, you should see lead volume begin to recover.
